description: Pin blocks (components, terminal strips or subsystems) at positions in one view, instead of where auto-layout puts them. x, y are the block's top-left, relative to its own subsystem in that view (layout_view shows current values). Unpinned blocks keep laying out automatically. Wires reroute in the app.

tag.description: Component tag, subsystem name, or a node id from layout_view (reference flags are x:…)

subsystem.description: Subsystem whose drill-down view this is (name or id). Omit for the project view.

name: set_block_positions
title: Set block positions
